__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: CoreLink Dedup + Eviction + Quota + LRU metrics datasource (Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics / Grafana Cloud)

title: CoreLink — Dedup + Eviction + Quota + LRU (DASH-DEDUP)
description: WI-S07-005 §6.1 canonical 10-panel S-07 ship-gate dashboard. Mirrors DASH-GC + DASH-MULTIPART pattern. Panels: dedup ratio per tier; bytes reclaimed last 30d; eviction rate per region; quota utilization heatmap; LRU drift p99; cascade prevention (BLOB-scope per Lote 10.7bis P0-8); 95% / 100% breach counters per tenant; INV-GC-001 inheritance canary; SOTA comparison vs NativeLink (~2.1×) / BuildBuddy (~2.8×); reservation TTL + LRU drop-counter cluster.

panels.title: Dedup ratio per tenant_tier (target ≥ 2.5× sustained 7d)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 1 + sprint contract §6 DoD + WI-S07-001 emit. Ratio = chunks_reused_total / (chunks_inserted_total + chunks_reused_total). Sustained ≥ 2.5× in ≥ 3 tenants is the S-07 ship-gate DoD; ≥ 3× stretch SOTA target. Anomaly drop > 30% WoW = SEV-2 (R-S07-7 anomaly detection).

targets.expr: avg by (tier) (sum by (tier) (rate(corelink_dedup_chunks_reused_total{tier=~"$tenant_tier"}[30d])) / clamp_min((sum by (tier) (rate(corelink_dedup_chunks_inserted_total{tier=~"$tenant_tier"}[30d])) + sum by (tier) (rate(corelink_dedup_chunks_reused_total{tier=~"$tenant_tier"}[30d]))), 1))

panels.title: Bytes reclaimed last 30d per tenant_tier (customer-visible CAP-EVICT-* + CAP-DEDUP-002)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 2 + sprint contract §10.s07.005.9 customer-visible metric forward S-16. `corelink_evict_bytes_reclaimed_total{tenant_id, tier}` aggregated 30d window. Surfaces customer dashboard `bytes_reclaimed_last_30d` (S-16 forward).

panels.title: Eviction rate per region (TTL + LRU + quota-trigger arms)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 3 + WI-S07-002 audit taxonomy. Per-region 5-min rate of soft-deletes (`evicted` arm); rate uplift correlates with 95% quota-trigger fire (§6 panel 7) and TTL expiry (`ttl_expired_total`).

panels.title: Quota utilization heatmap per tenant (top 50)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 4 + sprint contract R-S07-6. Threshold 0.80 = SEV-3 telemetry (Lote 10.7bis P0-4); 0.95 = SEV-2 + S-07 eviction trigger; 1.00 = S-08 hard-block boundary (ADR-0020 FROZEN). Top-50 enforced to avoid cardinality bomb (R-001 risk).

panels.title: LRU drift p99 (DO buffered vs D1 base UNION)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 5 + WI-S07-004 INV-LRU-CONSISTENCY. p99 of `corelink.lru.drift_ms` histogram; SLA target ≤ 60s; sustained > 60s SEV-2 (R-S07-006 LRU update hot path latency). Drift = max(deletion_observed_at, last_recorded_at) − D1 base.

panels.title: Cascade prevention (BLOB-scope per Lote 10.7bis P0-8)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 6 + INV-EVICT-CASCADE-PREVENTED + WI-S07-002. Pre-evict reachable check refuses if blob ref'd by active `ac_meta.blob_refs` (canonical `json_each` SQL idiom inherited from S-06). Counter `corelink_evict_cascade_prevented_total` strictly monotonic; non-zero rate signals adversarial pressure refused.

panels.title: 95% / 100% breach counters per tenant (top 20)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 7 + WI-S07-003 + ADR-0020 boundary. 95% breach = S-07 eviction trigger fired (`corelink_evict_quota_trigger_fired_total`); 100% breach = S-08 PROVISIONAL 429 + Retry-After (Lote 10.7-tris cycle 5 propagation; canonical S-08 ships rate-limit DO). Per-tenant top-20 enforced to avoid cardinality bomb.

panels.title: INV-GC-001 inheritance canary (MUST be 0; SEV-0 alert on > 0)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 8 + sprint contract §6 DoD invariant inheritance. `corelink_evict_gc_invariant_violation_total` MUST always = 0; `> 0` sustained 1 min = SEV-0 PagerDuty page Architect (INV-GC-001 inherited from S-06 GC). Cross-validated by `prop_evict_protect_if_re_referenced_strict_boundary` proptest @ 10k iter.

panels.title: SOTA comparison gauge — dedup ratio vs NativeLink (~2.1×) / BuildBuddy (~2.8×)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 9 + sprint contract §16 SOTA bench targets. Annotations: NativeLink OSS baseline 2.1×; CoreLink target 2.5×; BuildBuddy enterprise 2.8×; CoreLink stretch 3.0×. Marketing-claim defensibility (R-004 cherry-pick mitigated via 3-workload bench).

panels.title: Reservation TTL active + LRU drop-rate (FM-059 indicator + queue health)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 10 + WI-S07-003 INV-QUOTA-RESERVATION-TTL + WI-S07-004. `corelink_quota_reservation_active{tenant_id, region}` gauge tracks pending reservations (auto-release size-proportional TTL `min(7d, max(60s, req_bytes/1MB/s × 2))`). LRU `dropped_total{reason=queue_full}` sustained > 1k/min = SEV-2 (queue saturation; FM-059 adjacent).
